note: The gate's .rete fixtures, as RECIPE + ASSERTED PROPERTIES.
Every fixture is derived from a tracked source in this directory, by exactly
one producer (tests/gate/fixtures.sh). The `assert` block is what each
consuming check silently depends on; it is verified against the file the
recipe just produced, so a fixture that came out wrong fails NAMING ITSELF
instead of reddening the check that reads it.
`curatedFields` is the capability tripwire. A rete-cli older than
b7652657 (PR #161, 2026-08-04) accepts a card file carrying these keys,
exits 0, prints a plausible 'embedded dataset card (N bytes)' line — and
writes NONE of them, plus no build record. The fixture looks fine and
check_card_modal fails as if the playground were broken.
`buildRecord` is false for cardless builds by design: rete build attaches
the kind-7 section only to a card-carrying image, so a cardless file stays
